raw:
I didn't run any tools or look up the benchmark. These 30 hypotheses come from what I know of NAS-Bench-201, and none has been checked against the benchmark data. They rest on two mechanisms:

- **Bottleneck:** edge 0 is the only way into node 1, and edge 5 is the only way out of node 2. If either is `none`, edits to the edges behind or beyond it have little effect.
- **Diminishing returns:** edges 3, 4 and 5 all feed the output node. A strong op on one of them reduces what a second strong op or a skip adds on another.
